facts.fact: Slice is a technology platform built for independent pizzerias that supports more than 15,000 local pizza shops nationwide, according to Universal Ads' blog post.
facts.quote: supporting more than 15,000 local pizza shops nationwide, giving them tools for ordering, marketing, and operations

facts.fact: In a Universal Ads case described on its blog, Slice pizzerias that ran geo-targeted TV ads through Universal Ads in their served zip codes saw a 5% incremental lift in orders compared to similar shops that did not run TV advertising.
In the same Universal Ads case, Slice pizzerias that ran geo-targeted TV ads through Universal Ads saw a 3.2% incremental lift in sales compared to similar shops that did not run TV advertising.
